plugin.name: Code Map
plugin.description: Zero-dependency TypeScript symbol and reference map: browse symbols and callers in a side panel, and let agents locate code instead of grepping the whole tree.
map.empty.title: Build the code map to query symbols and references
map.empty.hint: Ask the agent to “build the code map” in the conversation; it scans the current workspace. Then use code_graph_query to locate symbols and callers.
map.overflow: …{count} more symbols. Use code_graph_query for exact lookup.
